system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"if you really cared, you'd fix your Roku app. Not being able to access my playlists is really getting in the way of my Xmas spirit."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! We totally get how important playlists are for your holiday vibes. Your feedback is being heard as we work with Roku on improvements! Let us know how it goes! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Tone could be more empathetic and offer a temporary workaround."}
